easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
